_about: Council-owned (or council-bookable) sports grounds where a private operator — a club, trust or council CCO — controls or sub-allocates the fields. Requests go through the operator first. Scope: the default Auckland view, North Harbour Stadium to Opaheke Sports Park. Researched 2026-09-30 from operators' public web pages; 'status' says how sure we are that the operator manages field use. Verify before relying on a contact.

workflow.label: Get the private operator's permission
workflow.detail: Ask the operator for the field, day and time. Get the yes in writing (email).

workflow.label: Apply to Auckland Council
workflow.detail: Submit the council booking application for the same slot. Note the operator's permission in the application.

workflow.label: Wait for council approval
workflow.detail: Wait for the council decision email from parksbookings@news.aucklandcouncil.govt.nz.

workflow.label: Confirm with the private operator
workflow.detail: Send the operator the council confirmation and lock in the slot, lights and access (keys, gates, changing rooms).

statuses.confirmed: The operator states that it takes field bookings, or AMUA has confirmed it
statuses.likely: The operator has a field-bookings or hire page for this ground
statuses.to-verify: Resident club with clubrooms and a seasonal allocation; ask whether it sub-allocates
